violations.text: A hose is connected to the faucet at the (mop sink). This faucet is lacking a backflow prevention device. An approved backflow prevention device is required in order to prevent backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply at each point of use at a food establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026
The multiple ceiling tiles in the (retail) area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
Various food was observed stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026
The outside refuse area was observed with an accumulation of debris. Refuse areas must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

The floors under the retail shelves have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026
An accumulation of trash and debris was observed around the refuse area. Area to be maintained clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/14/2025

The floors under retail shelves, throughout the facility, have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/14/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving (chip isle) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/26/2023

Refuse area was observed with an accumulation of litter and debris. Refuse area must be maintained clean and free of litter in order to prevent harborage conditions for pests. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/26/2023

The floors beneath market shelves and in the back room have an accumulation of soil residue and/or debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/26/2023
